periocular_spatial_geometry.dominant_axis_orientation: Near-vertical with a subtle lateral divergence of approximately 10 degrees from the vertical midline of the cranium.
periocular_spatial_geometry.aspect_ratio_factor: Elongated oval; vertical length is approximately 2.3 times the maximum horizontal width.
periocular_spatial_geometry.inferior_centroid_shift: Geometric center is shifted dorsally, resulting in a narrower, tapered profile at the bottom of the patch.

cranial_pinna_bounding_metrics.inter_bounding_box_euclidean_distance: Ears are widely set, separated by a distance roughly equal to 1.6 times the base width of a single ear region.
cranial_pinna_bounding_metrics.apex_contour_smoothness: Semicircular with a high degree of fuzzy texture at the boundary, maintaining a generally rounded apex.

other_distinctive_markers: Open oral cavity displaying tongue and teeth; bilateral manipulation of separate bamboo stalks in both forepaws.
